name: Cloudflare MCP servers
summary: Cloudflare's catalog of managed remote MCP servers: the Cloudflare API server (2,500+ endpoints behind search and execute tools) and sixteen product-specific servers on *.mcp.cloudflare.com (bindings, builds, observability, Radar, browser rendering, logs, AI Gateway, DNS analytics and more). One of the sixteen, the public Documentation server at docs.mcp.cloudflare.com, needs no authentication; the API server and the other product servers require OAuth or a token. Measured: the Documentation server answers with no credentials; the API and Radar servers answer 401. Code Apache-2.0.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-12 06:09Z, no credentials, cloud IP: Documentation server initialize 200 (docs-ai-search 0.4.13), tools/list 200 (2 tools), search_cloudflare_documentation 200 with results. API and Radar servers: 401 Bearer OAuth. Vendor: OAuth or an API token for the account-bound servers.
